changelog

oct 26, 2026

flipbook send fixed — sending a flipbook to chat used to ask which room with a popup that never shows on kindle, so nothing happened. now it shows tappable room buttons instead, so sending works everywhere.

critter release fixed + release to wild — releasing a critter from your team now always keeps it in your collection (before, starters vanished for good since they were never in the collection). plus a new "release to wild" button on collection critters that removes one forever, team included, for when the collection gets too cluttered.

pictionary: mouse drawing, more rounds, faster = more points — drawing with a mouse only painted one cell per click, now drag-painting works with a mouse just like touch. matches are now 8 rounds instead of 4, and guessing fast scores more (up to 100 for the guesser, 50 for the drawer) instead of flat points.

oct 25, 2026

critter catch: heal + team management — new "heal all" button on the critter screen restores your whole team to full hp. every team member now has a "release" button (asks first, and the critter stays in your collection), and every collection critter has an "add to team" button, so you can swap your party around. also fixed: fainting from a failed trap or a failed run now switches to your next critter (or sends you home to recover) instead of leaving the battle stuck.

mod helper applications fixed — the applications list in the mod dashboard was stuck on "loading..." forever because the rules didn't allow listing them. fixed the rules and the app: new applications now register in your own list too, and old ones get picked up the first time you open the dashboard.

dm dots that actually stick — the red dot next to each unread dm used to only show for messages that arrived while you were already on the site. now every dm tracks what you've read, so dots show for messages that came in while you were away too, and clear when you open that dm.

event countdown moved to halloween — the october event countdown now counts down to halloween at 12am instead of nov 8. doors and candy still run until nov 8.

oct 24, 2026

chess refresh — clearer board with rank/file coordinates on the edges, better contrast squares, a gold highlight for the selected piece, a red ring for captures, and a real red check warning (it used to be grey and easy to miss). pieces also got a soft shadow so they stand out more. same game, just easier on the eyes.

life sim ribbons on the title screen — the ribbons tab already showed your collected vs not-collected ribbons during a life, but now there's a ribbons button on the life sim title screen too, so you can check your collection before starting a new life.

notification tap fix — custom "notify me when someone talks" popups used to do nothing when tapped (they called a function that didn't exist). now tapping one jumps straight into that room, like the DM, poll, and mention popups already did.

oct 21, 2026

cookie clicker upgrades x9 — mega finger (+10/click), diamond finger (+25/click), plasma finger (+60/click), cookie factory (+25/sec), cookie mine (+100/sec), cookie portal (+500/sec), lucky charm (golden cookies show up twice as often and pay double), and two recipes that double ALL your production: butter recipe and secret recipe. happy clicking!

oct 18, 2026

mod helpers (MH) — new helper tier below mods! helpers can delete messages and mute rule-breakers for up to an hour. helper names show in italics.

apply to be a mod! — new app where you can apply to become a mod helper. chickn reviews every application.

8 games removed — mind reader, quiz zone, character creator, cube dash, recipe rush, slide puzzle, find the impostor, and one night at readium's are gone. 2048 stays!

pets gone for now — the ghost and turkey leg pets are out of the store, and pet tags no longer show by anyone's name.

pictionary rebuilt for kindle — the drawing board is now a tap-and-drag pixel grid (like flipbook) instead of a canvas, so drawing actually works on the kindle browser.

unread dm dot in chat — the red dot for unread dms now shows right on the chat screen too, not just inside the messages app. also fixed: the very first message in a new dm now pops up a notification like the rest.

new games fixed — the new games (2048, mind reader, quiz zone, character creator, cube dash, recipe rush, slide puzzle, find the impostor, one night at readium's) were opening to a blank screen. they work now.

sidebar moved — the nav bar is off by default now (turn it on in settings), sits at the bottom of the screen instead of the side, and collapses with the ▲ nav button so it takes up less space.

9 new games — impostor (find the impostor among the crew), mind reader (think of something, answer yes/no), 2048, quiz zone (personality quizzes), character creator (design a 16x16 character), cube dash, recipe rush (cooking game), slide puzzle, and five nights (survive the nights). all in the games tab!

solitaire upgrades — winning now shows a big "you win! +10 xp", the game auto-completes when everything's face-up (counts as a win even if you didn't sort every card yourself), and starting a new game mid-game asks for confirmation first.

per-account game saves — your cookie clicker, critter, life sim, alchemy, starfall and other saves are now tied to your account, so logging out and making a new account won't show someone else's progress. old saves carry over automatically.

life sim ribbons — new ribbons tab shows every ribbon you've earned and the ones you haven't. also fixed money showing $NaN when continuing as your child.

chess glow-up — warmer board colors and a cleaner frame.

notifications — tapping a popup notification now takes you straight to what it's about.

sidebar — new slim quick-nav bar with jumps to home, chat, DMs, games, apps, and settings. off by default, turn it on in settings.

kindle sites — new section on the all-apps screen with links to other kindle-made spots.

limited-time pets — ghost pet (until nov 8) and turkey leg (until nov 30) in the store for 500 xp each. when they're gone, they're gone!

oct 17, 2026

security fix — mod and founder powers are now locked to chickn's exact account. before, anyone with "chickn" in their email or name could get mod powers, and impersonator accounts were abusing it. that's gone now.

username screening — inappropriate usernames are now blocked at signup and show as "readerXXXX" everywhere instead of the dirty name. swept all existing usernames and banned the offenders.

stronger word filter — the filter now catches way more: more slurs, more sexual terms, more insults, plus smarter leetspeak tricks (like 8 for b, 6 for g). polls are now filtered too, like everything else.

starfall — a brand-new mini RPG! explore 3 areas, dodge enemy bullet patterns, recruit Pip and Bramble, and pick your ending: fight or spare? 9 enemies and 3 bosses.

critter pvp battles — challenge other players from their profile! turn-based battles with your real team, winner gets 20 xp. challenges expire after 5 minutes.

critter catch update — 24 critters now (stone, wind, and ice types are new!), with common/uncommon/rare rarities. starters evolve at level 8-10, and 5% of wilds are shiny! also harder: wilds can be stronger than you, bad matchups get resisted, traps are rarer, and wipes only revive at 25% hp. bug fixes too: caught critters now have the right stats for their level.

polls show who posted — every poll now says "posted by [name]" so you don't have to type your name in the question anymore.

alchemy cloud backup — your discovered elements are now backed up online, so they come back even if the kindle wipes its saved data.

cookie clicker upgrades — spend cookies on finger upgrades (+cookies per click), auto bakers, and bakeries that earn while you play! watch for golden cookies. leaderboard now ranks by total cookies.

critter cloud save — your critter team and collection are now backed up online and restored if the kindle wipes its data.

chess board fix — the 8th square doesn't wrap anymore, the board fits properly now.

what did you miss — when you sign in, a screen now shows what happened while you were away: mentions, new DM requests, new DMs, and new polls!

colorsoft mode — new appearance option in settings! soft colors made for the kindle colorsoft screen.

request dm button — profiles now have a "request dm" button that sends a DM request in one tap!

chat pfps fixed — profile pictures show next to names in chat again for everyone (no more blanks!).

profile decorations — my space is gone for now! the free decorations moved to your profile instead — pick up to 5 in your profile, they show under your bio.

delete polls — chickn can now delete any poll (asks to confirm first), and polls show two in each row now.

games grid — snake and cookie clicker tiles moved to the bottom of the games screen.

space decorations — decorate your space! free borders and decorations in the space editor.

font size fixed — the text size section in settings actually opens now. sorry about that!

fullscreen in settings — fullscreen toggle is now in settings.

delete account — new option in settings to delete your account forever (double confirm first).

polls back button — back button at the top of polls, no more scrolling down.

games grid fix — snake and cookie clicker tiles now sit side by side instead of stacking.

cookie clicker — new game! tap the cookie as fast as you can! most clicks leaderboard! features your custom cookie art!

976 alchemy elements — alchemy exploded from 60 to 976 elements! animals, food, fantasy, space, tech, and way more!

alchemy recipes fixed — 29 recipes weren't working (like mud+fire). all fixed now!

alchemy redesign — new mixing UI with two big boxes! tap elements to fill them, most recent at top, side menu so no scrolling!

poxel — new pixel art studio app! draw on 8x8, 16x16, or 32x32, save to gallery, set as your pfp!

custom notifications — tell the assistant bot "notify me when [username] talks" for custom popups! or "notify me when anyone talks"!

smarter bot — the assistant remembers your name, knows about all new features, and has 10 jokes!

open polls — anyone can post polls now! chickn can pin favorites to the top!

small text — new font size option! shrink text to 80% to see more messages!

gamble boards side by side — biggest winners and losers now display next to each other!

pfp fix — profile pictures always show now, no more blanks!

oct 16, 2026

poll comments — you can now comment under polls! tap "comments" on any poll.

most wins boards — every game with wins (tic tac toe, connect four, chess, solitaire, critter catch, pictionary) now shows a "most wins" leaderboard under the game!

notifications fixed — popups now appear wherever you are for new DM requests, new DM messages, mentions, and replies. tap one to jump right there!

play your luck fixed — the game opens again (it was crashing on start).

october event leaderboard fixed — the top candy collectors board loads again.

play your luck — new game! bet your xp on coin flips, dice rolls, and slots. biggest losers + biggest winners boards track it all!

neighborhood comments fixed — commenting on posts works again.

:3 reaction — you can now react with :3 on chat messages!

assistant app — public chatbot for everyone! ask about games, events, xp, or just chat. say 'joke' for a laugh!

XP reasons — mods can add a reason when granting XP, and the user sees a popup explaining why they got it!

mention dot fixed — the messages dot now goes away when you check your mentions.

DM send errors — if a DM fails to send, you'll now see what went wrong instead of silence.

smarter assistant — the chatbot now actually answers questions about games, events, xp, dms, and more!

oct 15, 2026

alchemy — new crafting game! mix elements to discover 60+ items.

game title screens — every game now has a title screen with description, settings, and start button.

popup notifications — toast popups for important events.

solitaire fixed — can now stack tableau cards by tapping them.

blank pfps fixed — now show a default face instead of invisible.

pets removed — all pets removed from store, bought pets cleaned up.

DM requests — better error messages when sending requests.

bug check — fixed fullscreen crash, poll dot, chess save/load, clock, logout button, dashboard feedback.

apps grid — all-apps screen now shows apps in a 2-column grid.

apps grid fix — the grid was wrapping into a single list on some browsers; buttons are now proper tiles in 2 columns, and the muse button stays hidden for non-founders.

oct 14, 2026

22-item update — dark mode, polls app, critter catch, store redesign, solitaire, and more!

oct 13, 2026

Zaya's game of life — new sandbox game! tap cells, press play, try the pulsar stamp.

DMs fixed — accepting a DM request works for everyone now.

mod dashboard — find-user search, and take away XP.

leaderboards fixed — event + XP boards load again.

october event v2 — team logos by your name everywhere, exact candy per door.

october event is LIVE — pick a team, knock on doors, win candy, climb the boards!

oct 9, 2026

store v2 — pixel pets, profile themes, XP boost, mystery box.

XP leaderboard — today / week / month / all-time boards.

suggestions — post ideas & bug reports, upvote/downvote, comment.

mod dashboard — reports queue, temp bans, moderator management.

life sim — full bitlife-style game: school, jobs, love, crime, fame.
